nodes.label: Premium SaaS design guardrails
nodes.rationale: Reuse tokens and primitives, design information hierarchy before decoration, preserve product workflows, and verify visual coherence before completing UI work.

nodes.label: Registration request fingerprints prevent duplicate retries
nodes.norm_label: registration request fingerprints prevent duplicate retries
nodes.rationale: A successful request retry retains its original approval state and does not create another member or duplicate audit action.

nodes.label: Server-only environment secrets and ignored production env file
nodes.norm_label: server-only environment secrets and ignored production env file
nodes.rationale: Keep database, session and R2 secrets outside client bundles and Git; retired OTP and Google configuration is no longer required.

nodes.label: Hierarchy and surface restraint replace competing decorative cards
nodes.norm_label: hierarchy and surface restraint replace competing decorative cards
nodes.rationale: Give monthly history primary weight, group real metrics together, simplify table boundaries and use neutral copy with meaningful accent colors rather than ornamental effects.

nodes.label: Whole-image palette comparisons fail despite applied measured tokens
nodes.norm_label: whole-image palette comparisons fail despite applied measured tokens
nodes.rationale: Reference frames, gradients, content proportions and palette clustering differ from the real management UI; failed whole-image scores must not be relabeled as fidelity passes or hidden by decorative additions.

nodes.label: Frontend measurements with explicit performance limitations
nodes.norm_label: frontend measurements with explicit performance limitations
nodes.rationale: Loopback TTFB, initial gzip bytes and SSR contracts cannot establish real browser performance, all-route savings, or responsive visual quality.
